subject: Embed governance and co-dev SOW for HelixAI integration
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@helix.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Alvarez <marco@helix.ai>, Anne Cho <anne.cho@helix.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: embed Redwood inference into Helix Insights — scope + next steps

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Helix is excited about having Redwood as the embedded inference layer inside Helix Insights. Marco and I sketched an initial scope and a short checklist for governance items we want covered in an SOW/partner addendum. High-level asks from our side:

- Co-development milestone: Redwood to deliver an embeddable runtime shim + thin SDK for our desktop/web client by end of Q1 2027.
- Branding + white-label: Helix will retain product branding; Redwood gets partner attribution in About -> Integrations. We need a brief brand usage guide and logo approval flow.
- Security/compliance: we need a statement on data residency, KMS integration, and a SOC2 excerpt.
- Support & SLA: 24/7 incident escalation path for P1s during launch window (first 90 days).

I attached a one-page SOW sketch (Helix_Embed_SOW_v1.pdf) and our brand assets. Can we get a quick alignment call with your engineering/program team next week?

Cheers,
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships
Helix AI

Attachments: Helix_Embed_SOW_v1.pdf, brand-guidelines-Helix.zip
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@helix.ai>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: embed Redwood inference into Helix Insights — scope + next steps

Priya — thanks for the clear checklist and the SOW sketch. This direction makes sense. Quick responses inline: 

- Co-dev milestone: we can commit a senior engineer + PM for the initial 12-week integration. We'll aim for an SDK epoch that supports both on-hosted Redwood Dedicated endpoints and Private deployments.
- Branding: agreeable. We have a short partner logo usage doc we can share — I'll attach and route sign-off flow (marketing + legal).
- Security: we can supply a KMS/HSM integration matrix and the SOC2 scope excerpt. For data residency, we should decide whether Helix wants session-level ephemeral tokens (recommended) or to persist transcripts in Helix storage; both are supported but have different obligations.
- SLA: we can provide an elevated 90-day launch SLA with a named on-call rotation.

Propose a 30-minute alignment call Mon 26 Oct 10:00 PT — does that work? Sergio, Karthik — can you join?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sdk-embed-guides.docx
From: Marco Alvarez <marco@helix.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@helix.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: embed Redwood inference into Helix Insights — scope + next steps

Thanks everyone — the 10:00 PT call worked well for us. A couple follow-ups Marco taking notes: 

- Product: Helix will ship a first integration for our Insights web app, mobile follows. We'll need a small native shim for iOS/Android later.
- Data handling: we prefer ephemeral session tokens + server-side transcripts stored in our tenant bucket (AES-256). Will need KMS integration details and a named contact for security review.
- Legal: Anne will circulate a short addendum for white-label usage; her initial ask: clarify trademark references and a 30-day notice before any public co-marketing.

We uploaded brand/UX mock screenshots to the shared Drive folder. Priya -> Anne will start the addendum draft.

—Marco
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@helix.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: embed Redwood inference into Helix Insights — scope + next steps

Appreciate the updates — adding a couple technical guardrails from the Redwood side that we should lock into the SOW: 

1) Runtime compatibility: supported model variants and quantization profiles will be listed as an appendix; if Helix requires cutting-edge quantized weights we may need a brief performance validation window (2–4 weeks) to hit latency targets.

2) Telemetry & observability: we will expose per-tenant token/latency metrics via our Console; for embed customers we can add a restricted view to Helix's Org. We need to agree on data retention (default 90 days) and which logs are shared.

3) Failure modes & fallback: specify a fallback plan (degraded local modality: short-answer client-side rules) plus automatic failover to a lower-cost model variant. We'll include an SLA credit schedule for availability below target during the launch window.

Karthik, Laura — can you prepare the technical appendix with sample perf numbers and the proposed telemetry contract? We'll attach that to the SOW draft.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@helix.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: embed Redwood inference into Helix Insights — SOW + DocuSign

Forwarding the attached SOW after tech appendix and legal comments incorporated. Key changes:

- Appendix A: supported models (RW-Base-v1, RW-Latency-quant-8) with sample latency at 512 tokens on g4dn equivalent.
- Appendix B: telemetry contract — shared metrics: per-tenant tokens, avg latency, P95 latency, error rates. Retention: 90 days by default, option to extend via add-on.
- Branding: 2-step logo approval; marketing reserves right for partner attribution copy.
- Security: KMS integration patterns documented; recommended: Helix manage keys via supported KMS vendor, Redwood supports envelope encryption.
- Commercials: 12-month co-dev SOW with milestone payments; first milestone (integration alpha) triggers DocuSign.

Attachments included: Helix_Embed_SOW_v1.pdf (updated), redwood-sdk-embed-guides.docx, brand-guidelines-Helix.zip

Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
